headline: Labor Groups Seek Government Action as NCR Wage Hike Faces Court Restraint
seoTitle: NCR Wage Hike Faces Court Restraint; Labor Groups Seek Action
seoDescription: Labor groups are pressing for action as litigation affects implementation of NCR Wage Order No. 27, which provides an ₱85 increase in two tranches.
deck: The wage dispute affects minimum-wage workers across Metro Manila.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: DOLE and PNA records confirm NCR Wage Order No. 27 provides an ₱85 increase in two tranches. The first ₱60 tranche took effect July 25, raising the non-agricultural daily minimum from ₱695 to ₱755, with a further ₱25 scheduled for January 20, 2027.

A Pasig RTC issued a temporary restraining order in late July against implementation of the wage order. The August 16 newsroom brief describes a later preliminary injunction and an FFW appeal; because the exact later court order was not independently retrieved, FMB News does not state that the procedural posture definitively changed from TRO to injunction.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: Corrected the email's claim that the wage would rise to ₱695; ₱695 was the prior non-agricultural rate.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: The dispute affects worker purchasing power, employer compliance and the authority of regional wage boards.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch for the Pasig RTC docket, DOLE/NWPC guidance and any appellate filing that changes the enforceability of Wage Order NCR-27.
